doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Jimmy Noon, Nene Quacku and the barbers
title: Tom watching Bolden's band, mesmerized, as a beginner
summary: Tom tells how, just starting to play, he stood watching the band so intently with his mouth open that he swallowed dirt while the people danced.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: That's right. Secret Hot Hall. That was out there. Well I'll tell you the trick of me. Butter Bowling was playing and Frank Reducing. And I was sitting down on the side of the... On the side of the plane, you know, I look. I had my mouth open like this. I looked at the plane and after I left the hall, I had so much dirt while the people was dancing.
Like you killed me. Yeah. All that dancing.

I looked at them playing, standing up there. I never looked at the people no more dead. I never did dead watching them playing. What was that? At the... At the Secret Hot Hall. No, not at the Secret Hot Hall. The Hall we called the... The Creole Hall? No.
The Hotfella Hall. The Hotfella Hall.

The Hotfella Hall. Yeah, that's what I'm... You know, out there. Yeah, and I'm so upset, you know. Yeah. Yeah, I stand up looking at them. I was just starting to play music then, you understand. I looked at them, and down like that. Out there, I did that. That's too much of dirt. Yeah. The people was dancing, you know, and I just swallowed the dirt. Yeah. So I was dancing. You think he was so good you just couldn't take your eye off of him?
